feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 29 September 2026 4:12am
items.description:
##Yesterday##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later, perhaps gale in the evening.


##Wind)##

E or SE 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 through the morning, perhaps gale 8 in places in the evening, veering S 3 to 5 overnight into Wednesday.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the west later.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, then rain overnight, heavy at times.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 19°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds for a time.


##Wind)##

S 3 to 5, increasing 5 to 7, veering SW 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain quickly clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, soon backing S 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming mainly moderate, occasionally rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then occasional rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Friday, 2 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

S 5 or 6, veering SW 4 or 5, becoming variable 3 or less later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough at first, soon becoming slight or moderate, then smooth or slight later.


##Weather)##

Risk of rain at first, this then clearing to showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Saturday, 3 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

Variable 3 or less, becoming S or SE 3 or 4.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather)##

Risk of rain at times.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
